passage.text: Last Friday, Emma and Nam took a taxi to the mall.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈfraɪdeɪ, ˈɛmə ənd ˈnɑːm ˈtʊk ə ˈtæksi tə ðə ˈmɔːl.

passage.text: Emma paid the driver, and they walked into the mall.
passage.reading: ˈɛmə ˈpeɪd ðə ˈdraɪvər, ənd ðeɪ ˈwɔːkt ɪntə ðə ˈmɔːl.

passage.text: "My phone isn't in my bag!" she said.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈfoʊn ˈɪzənt ɪn maɪ ˈbæɡ! ʃiː ˈsɛd.

passage.text: Nam called Emma's phone, and it rang and rang.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈkɔːld ˈɛməz ˈfoʊn, ənd ɪt ˈræŋ ənd ˈræŋ.

passage.text: Twenty minutes later, the taxi driver returned to the mall.
passage.reading: ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ˈleɪtər, ðə ˈtæksi ˈdraɪvər rɪˈtɜːrnd tə ðə ˈmɔːl.

passage.text: He was an honest man, and he gave the phone back to Emma.
passage.reading: hiː wʌz ən ˈɑːnɪst ˈmæn, ənd hiː ˈɡeɪv ðə ˈfoʊn ˈbæk tə ˈɛmə.

passage.text: Emma was so happy, and she bought him a coffee.
passage.reading: ˈɛmə wʌz ˈsoʊ ˈhæpi, ənd ʃiː ˈbɔːt hɪm ə ˈkɔːfi.
